description: This file defines the SocksInterceptor class which manages SOCKS proxy handling, message interception, and event handling for SOCKS support within a WebSocket transport context.

classes.name: SocksInterceptor
classes.description: Manages SOCKS proxy events, message interception, and communication over WebSocket transport.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes SocksInterceptor with transport, pattern, and redirect port; sets up event handlers.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up SOCKS proxy handler resources.

methods.name: interceptMessage
methods.description: Intercepts messages to handle SOCKS support and data exchange.
